# Deduplicate articles by canonical URL

## Context and Problem Statement

The same article reaches us through several feeds, with tracking parameters that
differ per source. Identity by feed entry id produced visible duplicates.

## Decision Outcome

Every article gets a canonical URL: scheme and host lowercased, tracking query
parameters dropped, fragment removed. That canonical form is the deduplication
key on the ingestion queue consumer described in [[000003]].

## Consequences

Duplicates disappear from the reading list. Publishers that vary content by query
parameter are collapsed incorrectly, which we accept for now.
